item.title: Jury Says Bill Cosby Drugged and Raped a Woman in 1972, Awards Her $59 Million
item.description: A civil jury in California found Monday that Bill Cosby was liable for drugging and sexually assaulting a woman in 1972 and awarded her $59.25 million.

item.title: Khan: With Trump in Power, Only Europe Can Provide Security for Britain
item.description: London Mayor Sadiq Khan said Britain is not safe with Trump in power and therefore the UK should seek to rejoin the EU for protection.

item.title: Spain’s Socialist PM Sánchez Scolds U.S-Israel over 'Illegal' Iran War
item.description: Spain’s socialist PM Pedro Sánchez scolded the U.S. and Israel for their attacks on Iran, calling the conflict an "absurd, cruel and illegal" challenge to international law.

item.description: British military officers are embedded with CENTCOM in preparation for a long-term Strait of Hormuz freedom of navigation mission.

item.title: Jimmy Kimmel Freaks over Trump’s Response to Robert Mueller's Death: 'Petty Little Bitch'
item.description: Left-wing television host Jimmy Kimmel attacked President Donald Trump over his response to the death Robert Mueller, a former FBI director and Special Counsel for an infamous and drawn-out hoax targeting Trump.

item.title: New Mexico Jury Rules Zuckerberg's Meta Failed to Protect Children, Orders $375 Million in Damages
item.description: A New Mexico jury has ruled that Mark Zuckerberg's Meta must pay $375 million in civil damages after finding the social media giant violated state law by failing to protect children from predators on its platforms.

item.title: Iran War Hits Taliban as Afghan Refugees Return Home
item.description: The Taliban appears to be struggling with Afghan refugees fleeing the war in Iran and detentions in shipments in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Vince Vaughn: Late-Night Comedy 'Stopped Being Funny,' Became 'Agenda-Driven,' 'A F**king Class I Didn’t Want to Take'
item.description: Hollywood star Vince Vaughn lamented the politicization of late-night comedy through the years, saying the major network shows all fused into a singular narrative that felt less like comedy and more like a lecture.

item.title: Disney Deal with OpenAI 'Not Moving Forward' After Sora Video App Shut Down News
item.description: OpenAI announced that it will be shutting down its Sora AI video app on Monday, effectively killing its deal with Disney.
